Actually "neighboring communities plus the current one" means we consider the current community and all communities that the node has edges to. So we do not consider creating a new community. That is typical for the local moving phase in the Leiden algorithm. The "plus the current one" ensures we consider staying. So we only evaluate gain for communities that appear in the neighbor set, and we also compare with staying (gain 0). So we only consider moving to a community if there is at least one edge from i to that community. So we won't create a new community. That's fine.
